payload.title: Stream cursor query API: /cursor head probe + ?since forward reads
payload.description: GET /streams/:type/:id/cursor returns {headSequence,count}; GET /streams/:type/:id?since=<seq> returns events after a cursor ascending. Backed by StreamStore.readAfter + headSequence. NOTE: this work was implemented and merged to main (commit 2a679d5, test repaired in c6e4e88) but was MISLABELED FR-116 in its commit/CHANGELOG. This ticket retroactively captures it accurately.
